root_cause_criterion.description: Before `calloc`, `pimasize` must be at least `sizeof (IMA_ADPCM_PRIVATE) + psf->sf.channels * (blockalign + samplesperblock + sizeof (short) * (((samplesperblock - 2) | 7) + 2))` so the WAV IMA scratch area includes the decoder's 8-nibble rounding even when the later `samplesperblock == count` consistency check passes.
root_cause_criterion.fix_mechanism: Compute the rounded decoded-scratch count `((samplesperblock - 2) | 7) + 2` before `calloc` and size `pimasize` from that rounded count instead of from `3 * psf->sf.channels * samplesperblock` alone.

nodes.description: At the protected `pima->samples [indx] = bytecode & 0x0F` store, the write extends to byte 16 of `pima->data` while the vulnerable tail budget carried into the decoder is only 14 bytes, so the final store overruns the undersized object.

edges.description: The vulnerable tail-budget formula `blockalign * psf->sf.channels + 3 * psf->sf.channels * samplesperblock` is fixed at `ima_reader_init()` and reaches the sink unchanged through `pima->blocksize`, `pima->channels`, and `pima->samplesperblock`.
